field_evidence.dataset_scope: INSPIRE Index Polygons contains locations of freehold registered property in England and Wales.
field_evidence.identifier_semantics: Each INSPIRE Index Polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title.
field_evidence.geometry_semantics: Polygons show the position and indicative extent of a registered property.
field_evidence.access_format: The guidance directs users to the Use land and property data service; files are published as GML.
field_evidence.canonical_extent_limitation: Definitive title extent is not established by the INSPIRE polygon itself; target-specific title-plan context is required before canonical parcel geometry can be asserted.
